name: Sourced content, favorites, and dhikr counters
description: Users find sourced hadith and duas, retain and remove favorites, and persist or reset dhikr counts on mobile.
steps: Open الأحاديث النبوية from the sidebar.
Search for الكلمة الطيبة and verify the matching sourced excerpt.
Click its حفظ في المفضلة button.
Open المفضلة and verify الكلمة الطيبة is present.
Reload, open المفضلة and verify it remains.
Remove that favorite, reload and verify it is absent from المفضلة.
Open the mobile menu and choose الأدعية والأذكار.
Choose بعد الصلاة and increment التسبيح بعد الصلاة twice.
Reload, return to that category, and verify the count is ٢ / ٣٣.
Reset that counter and verify ٠ / ٣٣.
Choose أدعية قرآنية, save طلب العلم, and verify it in المفضلة with سورة طه citation.
Open الأحاديث النبوية, find الرفق زينة, click شرح الحديث and verify the attributed summary and link to hadeethenc.com/ar/browse/hadith/5796. Collapse and reopen the explanation.
expected: The selected hadith is searchable, displays its Bukhari citation, survives reload when saved, and remains absent after removal. The menu works on mobile, the count survives reload and resets to zero, and the saved dua is present with its source.

name: Read, resume, and listen to Quran
description: Users resume reading and play actual audio with working controls that persist across in-app navigation.
covers: actual media playback and native seeking
shared audio across home and catalog
Muyassar/Jalalayn switching and aligned verse text
steps: Open القرآن الكريم. If the provider is unavailable, verify the visible error and إعادة المحاولة; retry once and use the offline سورة الفاتحة to complete the reader checks.
When the full index is available search الإخلاص and open it; verify the Quran text is displayed. If surah loading fails, verify retry and open سورة الفاتحة instead.
Increase and decrease the font using تكبير خط القرآن and تصغير خط القرآن.
Reload and click متابعة القراءة on the home page.
Open القرّاء والتلاوات and search الحصري. Select محمود خليل الحصري.
Choose حفص عن عاصم - مرتل, search الفاتحة in the surah search, and play it.
Verify audio duration becomes positive and currentTime advances; pause and verify paused state; resume.
Navigate to الرئيسية and verify the bottom player still shows الحصري and audio continues.
Use السورة التالية and verify البقرة is selected, then السورة السابقة to return to الفاتحة.
Use إيقاف التلاوة من البداية and verify paused audio with currentTime zero.
Navigate to الرئيسية. Verify the visible مشغل القرآن في الرئيسية card appears before خيرٌ يرافق يومك and does not start audio automatically on first visit.
Choose محمود خليل الحصري using قارئ مشغل الرئيسية and حفص عن عاصم - مرتل using رواية مشغل الرئيسية. Select سورة الفاتحة using سورة مشغل الرئيسية.
Click تشغيل القرآن من الرئيسية and verify actual audio duration and currentTime increase. Pause with إيقاف مؤقت من الرئيسية, then resume.
Seek with تقدم التلاوة في الرئيسية and verify the audio playhead follows. Set سرعة التلاوة to 1.25× and verify playbackRate changes. Toggle تكرار and verify loop changes.
Use السورة التالية من الرئيسية to select البقرة, then السورة السابقة من الرئيسية to return to الفاتحة.
Open كل القرّاء, verify the same audio continues in the persistent player; return to الرئيسية and verify the same track and progress.
Select ٥ د in مؤقت النوم بالدقائق. Advance the browser clock by five minutes using a browser clock fixture, then focus the page and verify audio pauses and the expiry message is visible.

Start Al-Fatiha with a selected reciter. Verify Media Session metadata shows the same surah and reciter, and invoke registered play, pause, seek, next and previous actions through a browser harness; verify the audio follows and explicit pause is not undone.

Bring a second browser tab to the foreground for several seconds, then return. Verify the original audio element remains mounted and its playhead advanced. Repeat while paused and verify it stays paused. This does not substitute for a physical Android screen-lock test.
Open الخلفية وشاشة القفل, verify the Android guidance and browser limitations, then close it without stopping audio.
Open القرآن الكريم, read سورة الفاتحة, and click تفسير الآية 2. Verify the view identifies Al-Fatiha verse 2, shows its Quran text, and attributes التفسير الميسّر to مجمع الملك فهد.
Choose تفسير الجلالين and verify the source and explanatory text change while the verse stays aligned; use next/previous verse and قراءة السورة.
Open Al-Fatiha in الحفظ آية بآية. Mark verse 1 with أتممت حفظ الآية; verify verse 2 and 1/7 progress. Move forward once without confirming and verify verse 3 and unchanged 1/7.
Reload, select متابعة الحفظ on home, and verify verse 3 resumes. Select verse 1, cancel its memorization confirmation, and verify 0/7 with verse 1 retained. Hide and reveal the verse.

Choose verse 7 and mark it; verify there is no verse 8 and moving forward is disabled. Complete remaining verses and verify full-surah completion. Visit a second surah and confirm independent progress.
Block localStorage.setItem for the progress key and verify a visible persistence warning after changing verse.

Start a reader and choose a different surah via اختيار سورة من المشغل. Verify the audio source changes but reader and recording remain the same. Return home and switch سورة مشغل الرئيسية while playing; verify the new surah starts.
expected: A successfully loaded surah displays verse numbers and is resumed after reload. Font controls change the text size. Any provider failure has a visible explanation and retry button, and Al-Fatiha remains readable. Real audio loads and advances, controls work, source/reciter labels match, and the same player survives page navigation. The embedded home card controls the same single audio element, exposes real progress, and speed, repeat, seek, and timer expiry work. Memorization position and confirmed verses survive reload independently for each surah, no verse is marked by navigation alone, and the last-verse boundary is respected.

name: Prayer settings and notification permissions
description: Prayer calculation preferences persist and notifications cannot appear enabled without permission.
steps: Open مواقيت الصلاة using the mobile menu.
Select الرياض and أم القرى; verify six times and the upcoming prayer are displayed.
Reload and return to مواقيت الصلاة; verify the city and method persist.
Click تفعيل التنبيهات. If prompted, deny permission.
Verify a visible permission or unsupported-browser message if permission is unavailable. If already granted, verify the enabled state and then disable it.
Verify the page explains that alerts require the app to remain open.
expected: Prayer times are displayed for Riyadh with saved calculation settings; permission denial does not enable alerts, and the foreground-only limitation is visible.

name: Mobile catalog, empty states, and installation
description: Users can recover empty searches, install the web app, and select only available recordings with saved reader preferences.
covers: install guidance or native install prompt
steps: Open الأحاديث النبوية and search zzznonexistent. Verify لا توجد نتائج, then clear the search and verify results return.
Open القرآن الكريم. If its full index loads, search zzznonexistent and verify the no-surah message.
Click ثبّت سكينة على جهازك. Verify either the browser install prompt or the سكينة على موبايلك dialog.
If the dialog is shown, verify Android Chrome instructions and that the app is described as a web app, then close it.
Open the menu and القرّاء والتلاوات.
Search ماهر المعيقلي, select the reader and choose حفص عن عاصم - المصحف المعلم.
Verify only 38 surahs are available; search البقرة and verify no audio option is fabricated.
Clear surah search, play الفاتحة and enable تكرار السورة. Verify the native audio loop property is true; turn it off and enable تشغيل السورة التالية تلقائيًا.
Reload, return to القرّاء والتلاوات, and verify the selected reader/recording remain.
Search zzznonexistent in the reader field, verify the empty message, then click عرض كل القرّاء to restore results.

On a 375px-wide viewport, use التنقل الرئيسي to open الرئيسية, verify the home player card and its selectors fit without horizontal overflow, start and pause a surah from the card, then navigate through القرآن and الأذكار using the bottom navigation. Confirm buttons are not covered by the hosting badge.
Use بحث in التنقل الرئيسي. Search الحصري and open محمود خليل الحصري; verify the selected reciter in the audio library.
Return to بحث, enter الإخلاص, choose السور and open قراءة السورة. Verify Al-Ikhlas is shown.
Return to بحث, search الرفق, choose الأحاديث and open قراءة الحديث وشرحه; verify the correct hadith and expanded explanation.
Return to بحث, enter الرحمة, choose التفاسير and submit. Verify real sourced explanation matches and open one via قراءة الآية وتفسيرها; verify matching surah/ayah.
Type a new query quickly while a tafsir request is in flight and verify old matches do not replace the new query results. Search zzznonexistent under القرّاء and verify an explicit empty state.
expected: Searches never fabricate results; clearing restores entries, and installation shows a browser prompt or accurate Android instructions. No horizontal overflow; saved reader/recording restore without autoplay, only available surahs are shown, and toggles and empty state recovery work. The mobile bottom navigation and home player work without horizontal overflow or obscured controls.

name: Audio catalog and media network failures
description: Failed refreshes retain the catalog and failed audio shows a retry that can recover.
covers: tafsir search error retains local matches
steps: Open القرّاء والتلاوات and click تحديث الفهرس; verify the resulting success message and list.
Simulate offline network in the browser and click تحديث الفهرس again; wait for the request timeout and verify the cached catalog remains available with an error message.
Select a surah not previously loaded and attempt playback while offline; verify a visible audio error and إعادة محاولة الصوت.
Restore the network, retry the audio, and verify duration is positive and playback progresses.

Block api.alquran.cloud with browser route interception. Open a tafsir that was not previously cached; verify error and إعادة تحميل التفسير. Restore the network and retry, then verify real text appears.
Block the tafsir search endpoint and search القرآن from البحث الشامل. Verify the remote error is explicit and local surah/hadith results remain available.
In a separate fresh browser context with mediaSession unavailable, start a surah and verify normal playback still works and background help accurately states that lock-screen buttons are unavailable.
expected: Refresh failure retains the complete saved catalog. Audio failure is visible and retry works after the network is restored.
